## Purpose

State the one observable change to the clean-context evaluator or its
evidence contract.

## Evidence

- [ ] `npm run verify`
- [ ] `git diff --check`
- [ ] Product, Bench, and Judge revisions (or their absence) are stated.
- [ ] unavailable, failed, abstained, and unmeasured states are explicit.

## Boundary check

- [ ] No Bench case or Ground Truth was changed by an Eval run.
- [ ] No Product internals, credentials, private environment dump, sealed
      material, or personal data entered a public artifact.
- [ ] Roast/Brew and output-quality/triggering boundaries remain separate.
- [ ] No Product-performance, activation, or merge claim is inferred from a
      runner result alone.
